newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton steady on limited demand, supplies.
newsitem.headline: India cotton steady on limited demand, supplies.

text.p: Cotton prices held steady at the improved level on the local market on Thursday, dealers said.
Supplies and offerings remained limited but demand resistance from millers at the improved level kept prices quiet after recent gains.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 1,010/1,080 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) as was Punjab saw-ginned at 1,825/1,875 rupees per maund and F-414 at 2,060/2,080 rupees per maund.
In the Gujarat segment, Kalyan cotton was steady at 14,500/14,800 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) as was Kala-ginned at 12,400 rupees and Wagad cotton at 13,100 rupees per candy.
"Volume remained at a low ebb as major players kept to the sidelines keeping an eye on the progress of monsoon," one broker said.
"Progress of monsoon is slow for the second round in major producing states and sentiment was firm at close of the session," he added.
